prompts.t:
RELAY for mastermind-sessions-grid (from owner). File or find the card, give a one-line answer, then pass the ask on with send_to_agent({id: "mastermind-sessions-grid", text, from: "master-assistant"}), keeping the owner's words verbatim:

New owner ask (2026-10-12), add to your brief: on /framework/ai/sessions/ the owner cannot tell which row is the tab they are talking to. Each row must show (1) the tab's own title as the owner sees it (the VS Code sidebar tab title, e.g. "Usage"; the phone/app title) plus a registered name if any (register_session id, e.g. this one is night-mastermind = session 87bec773-d6dd-421c-92cc-fdd8a9eb5103), (2) the CURRENT model (read from the latest turn, not the first; this session moved Sonnet→Opus and the grid still shows Sonnet), (3) last activity time, with live sessions grouped at the top under "Now" and stale ones (no turn in hours) below. Test with 87bec773: it must be findable at a glance. Record in your asks entry; commit; merge.
